entries.title: Sources opens on Where it sits
entries.body: When you open Sources on one of your own articles, it starts on Where it sits, beside Bibliography and Links. It brings together the papers that cite the piece, the most relevant works from its bibliography, and a button to search the literature, which no longer needs the Experimental features switch. Opening it may build the bibliography if the article has none yet; the literature search runs only when you press its button.

entries.title: Reception and Claims wait for you to start
entries.body: Opening Reception (Pages about it) or Claims (Check a claim), including from the command bar, no longer starts a search or a list of claims by itself. Press Search the web or List its claims inside the tool when you want one.

entries.title: Sources groups related works and repeats fewer papers
entries.body: Some papers listed twice under one title among those citing the piece are shown once. Not cited puts likely other editions, and works by the same authors, into their own groups. The literature search also searches by title and authors' surnames, leaves out some unsuitable sources, and a chat started from one of its findings stays linked to it.

entries.title: Your library shows reading progress on some articles
entries.body: On your library, an article's card or row can show the same small pie of your reading progress as the reading view, after its reading-time estimate. It appears only once enough of your reading of that article has been recorded, so many articles will not show one, and it is never shown in the public library.

entries.title: Upload limits sit behind an (i) beside File
entries.body: The upload limits that were written out under the box for adding an article have moved into an (i) button beside File. Point at it, move to it with the keyboard, or tap it to read them. Screen readers still read them out with the File button.

entries.title: Signed-out pages start below the iPhone clock
entries.body: On an iPhone, at least when Spideryarn was added to the home screen, the top bar of the home page, Features, Pricing, Sign in and the public library was drawn under the clock and status bar. It starts below them.
